syllabus_extraction.text:
UNIT-I AUTOMATA FUNDAMENTALS: Introduction to formal proof, Finite Automata (FA), Deterministic Finite Automata (DFA), Non-deterministic Finite Automata (NFA), Transition diagrams.
UNIT-II REGULAR EXPRESSIONS AND LANGUAGES: Regular Expressions, Equivalence of DFA and Regular Expressions, Pumping Lemma for regular languages.

UNIT 1 INTRODUCTION TO DBMS: Database System Applications, View of Data, Database Languages, Relational Databases, Database Design.
UNIT 2 RELATIONAL MODEL AND SQL: Structure of Relational Databases, Database Schema, Keys, Schema Diagrams, Query Languages, SQL Data Definition.

UNIT-I PROCESS MANAGEMENT: Introduction to OS, Process Concept, Process Scheduling, Operations on Processes, Inter-process Communication.
UNIT-II PROCESS SYNCHRONIZATION: The Critical-Section Problem, Peterson's Solution, Synchronization Hardware, Mutex Locks, Semaphores.

UNIT I PHYSICAL LAYER: Introduction, Data and Signals, Digital Transmission, Analog Transmission, Multiplexing.
UNIT II DATA-LINK LAYER: Link Layer Addressing, Error Detection and Correction, Data Link Control, Media Access Control.

UNIT I SOFTWARE PROCESS MODELS: Introduction to Software Engineering, Software Process, Perspective and Specialized Process Models.
UNIT II REQUIREMENTS ANALYSIS AND SPECIFICATION: Software Requirements, Functional and Non-Functional, User requirements, System requirements.
expected_units: UNIT II: REQUIREMENTS ANALYSIS AND SPECIFICATION
